tools.name: get_trace_schema
tools.description: Return the exact input format TraceCheck's evaluate_trace expects, the scored dimensions and weights, and a complete example call you can copy. Call this once before your first evaluate_trace. No arguments, no side effects.

tools.name: evaluate_trace
tools.description:
Get an independent, deterministic reliability check of a multi-step task you (an agent) just ran. Returns a 0-100 score, the issues found, and concrete fixes to apply on your next attempt.

WHEN TO CALL: after you finish (or give up on) a multi-step task that used tools, before you report "done" to
